event.details: Members only. Ring hire by the half hour.
event.name: Members' Ring Time

body.privacyNotice: We store your name, your dog's name and the slot you choose so the club can run the event. The club's organisers can see these details; other people using this page only see which slots are taken. The organisers may share the running order, with names, with other participants (for example in a group chat). The details are kept until an organiser deletes the event; nothing is deleted automatically.
